judgments.reason: The OMEGA paper (Niso et al. 2016) is the archive's official reference. The dataset README says to cite it, and the dataset is an OMEGA resting-state sample with matching authors.
The paper specifies the MEG-BIDS standard, which the dataset uses for its organization. It doesn't describe the OMEGA resting-state sample itself.
judgments.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
